apothecary.legal_bias: poisons can be hidden unless the shop is explicitly illicit

rules.specific_item_check: Generate the seeded inventory using the selected settlement and shop, then search that persistent stock list. The same seed and settings always return the same answer.
rules.stock_persistence: Generated inventory is identified by its seed and settings. Retain those values until the GM intentionally rerolls stock.
rules.enchanted_objects: Do not treat as normal priced stock. Generate only for curiosity shops, auctions, patrons, treasure, or explicit GM override; price remains GM-set.
rules.incantations: Generate a rank template from items.csv, then select a spell of the same rank from the spell CSV files. Apply shop and rarity restrictions.
rules.seed: Hash the complete seed string and use a deterministic pseudo-random number generator. Seed plus settlement plus shop is the reproducible inventory key.
